item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 04/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will moderate gradually today and tomorrow. Daytime temperatures will rise slightly over the coast of Guangdong. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Wednesday. There will be one or two rain patches over the region. The dry continental airstream associated with the monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to Guangdong in the following couple of days. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudier with a few rain patches over the coast of Guangdong over the weekend.
